style.checked: One cinematic full-frame fictional everyday threshold photograph; near dark wall identity and far bright wall information with diagonal light
style.observation: Implemented with a blue-gray near wall, central wood-framed window, oblique warm light and deep right opening. Title scale and surface texture deviations are recorded as residuals.

flat_opaque.observed: Single edge-to-edge flat poster; no mockup or comparison panel
flat_opaque.opaque_metadata_observation: PNG color type 2; RGB without alpha

substantive_visual.observation: Window, close wall return, far opening and diagonal daylight on a continuous floor establish architectural observation and depth; image is not subordinate inset or bottom-strip content.

template_exclusion.observation: Actual near and far walls with continuous floor and daylight organize the distributed text. Removing the photo removes the threshold and depth reading route. The two wall tones are visible parts of the photographed scene rather than passive split-color panels.

hangul.observation: Title and practical Hangul syllable proportions, stroke joins, counters and word boundaries were inspected at native and usage720; no specific malformed glyph was observed.

information_relationship.observation: Subtitle combines photo exhibition with space story; free/commentary line reinforces the shared interpretation. Schedule, venue and admission sit together; capacity/registration sit below; welcome and visiting guidance remain at lower right.

function_contact.observation: No contact, application URL or mechanism was supplied; no such copy has been invented. Advance-registration condition is printed.

material_edge_finish.observation: Rough foreground plaster is visible; window reveals, wall return, floor transition and far opening remain separate and legible.

located_observations.location: continuous window, threshold and diagonally lit floor between left and right text
located_observations.observation: The substantial architectural photograph shows light falling through a window and across a threshold; the exhibition/talk subtitle and free/commentary line identify it as a shared viewing event.

located_observations.location: lower-left title, central light, upper-right details
located_observations.observation: The ivory serif title is the strongest first text anchor. The central window and illuminated floor expose depth; the contrasting upper-right schedule is the next useful information group. Participation and lower-right welcome remain separate discoverable groups.

located_observations.location: title and all three right-side information groups
located_observations.observation: Serif Hangul retains distinct syllables and counters; sans serif practical copy has consistent strokes and visible word spaces. Two title lines, a single subtitle line, four schedule lines and two lines in each remaining group are observed. Time punctuation has two colons and a centered dash with an en-dash-like length.

located_observations.location: near wall return around x300, distant wall and floor
located_observations.observation: The photographed foreground wall, window, far opening and oblique floor continue across the frame. Flat horizontal copy aligns with readable natural surfaces; no inset photo, bottom image strip or inserted information card is visible.

located_observations.location: blue-gray foreground plaster, wood window reveal, far opening and floor contacts
located_observations.observation: Plaster texture varies visibly, opening and wall return edges are firm, and the natural window light continues onto the wall and floor. No film dust, invented print marks, furniture, people or framed artwork appears.

located_observations.location: warm daylight interior and lower-right reassurance
located_observations.observation: Ordinary plaster, a simple window and empty walkable floor convey quiet curiosity. The visiting and reassurance text is readable, with no real-building identity or institution branding visible.

The continuous scene and near/far type placement carry the composition. There are no arbitrary graphic ornaments, tiny pseudo-copy, logos, QR codes or visible watermark. Foreground plaster is coarse, but no conspicuous broken letter or merged architectural edge was observed.

residuals.observation: Title is visibly larger and heavier than the 37 px normal-weight planning guide; it remains below the English companion with the requested two-part title grouping.
Blue-gray plaster has a coarse raised texture rather than the planned smoother surface.
These are the smallest practical-copy lines, readable in the inspected 720-pixel image but less robust than the upper-right schedule at smaller displays.
Raster shape supports the observed punctuation transcription; original Unicode code points cannot be authenticated from pixels.

decision.reason: All eleven entries were read at usage720 and checked in the native revisit. The continuous threshold image and information route work; guide deviations do not demonstrate a repair benefit.
